# binaries

The `postgres-binaries` dependency — see the parent's [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md) (§ Topology, "Binaries pinned outside the checkout") for how the start script runs it and how a version switch happens.

A plugin of its own on purpose: a `deps/` barrel is a shipped runtime, so declaring it in `database/embedded` itself made every composition reaching the database plugins (the public website included) carry `infra/deps` whole. Only the start script (a leaf `scripts/` file) and the deps registry import this one.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The postgres-binaries dependency: the embedded cluster's server binaries, an infra/deps package copy of this platform's @embedded-postgres package outside the checkout, pinned (holder machine-postgres) — the start script runs the pinned install, switched only by ./equin deps pin postgres-binaries. A child of its own so no composition's closure reaches the deps engine through the database plugins.
- Deps:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/deps.defineDep`
    - `infra/deps/package-copy.npmPackageCopy`
  - Exports (values): `postgresBinaries`
